response.sql:
WITH counts_by_type AS (
    SELECT
        t.tradekind,
        COUNT(*) AS analysis_count
    FROM advancedbehavior AS ab
    JOIN transactionrecord AS tr
      ON tr.transreg = ab.translink
    JOIN trader AS t
      ON t.tradereg = tr.trdref
    GROUP BY t.tradekind
),
shares AS (
    SELECT
        tradekind,
        analysis_count,
        analysis_count::numeric / SUM(analysis_count) OVER () AS share
    FROM counts_by_type
),
averages AS (
    SELECT AVG(analysis_count) AS avg_count
    FROM counts_by_type
)
SELECT
    SUM(s.analysis_count) AS sum_counts,
    AVG(s.share) AS average_share,
    AVG(s.analysis_count - a.avg_count) AS average_excess_count
FROM shares AS s
CROSS JOIN averages AS a
WHERE s.analysis_count > a.avg_count;

assumptions.assumption: The request’s final instruction asks for one summary row over trader types strictly above the average, so the primary query returns that summary only; the per-type counts and shares are used to calculate it. The average count is across trader types represented among analyses with existing linked transaction records and traders.
